Native-safe ports of the removed dependencies: (a) @/hooks/useAsOfDate URL `?as_of=` state -> a module-level store (asOfValue + asOfListeners) exposing the identical { asOf, setAsOf, clear } contract; setAsOf clears on null/'' and rejects non-RFC-3339 via the ported looksLikeIso (ISO_RFC3339_RE + Date.parse/Number.isFinite), exactly as the web hook refuses to write malformed values. AS_OF_QUERY_PARAM ('as_of') is preserved verbatim so a native data layer can still attach `as_of` to request URLs and reroute reads through signal_log. (b) The TIME_MACHINE_OPEN_PICKER_EVENT window event -> subscribeTimeMachineOpenPicker / emitTimeMachineOpenPicker module registry (the command palette calls emit exactly as the web dispatches the window event). (c) formatDateTime/toLocalDatetimeStr ported with identical behaviour (Intl.DateTimeFormat year/month/day/hour/minute; '—' for nullish/invalid; zero-padded local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss). __resetTimeMachineForTests added as a test-only seam to reset the singleton store + listeners.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, window/document, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web @/components/ui imports in the native output — only react, react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/TextInput/View/TextStyle), the local AppText component, and theme tokens.
